prose.en: In judo you apply techniques and defend against the opponent's techniques while moving, so it is important to move while keeping your own posture stable. The basic ways of walking in these advancing and retreating movements are tsugi-ashi (following foot) and ayumi-ashi (walking foot). In doing so, using suri-ashi (sliding foot) makes the posture stable.
Rather than one foot passing the other as you walk, you walk by bringing one foot up to follow the other.
Mainly a way of walking forward and backward; the ordinary way of walking, stepping out alternately with the left and right feet.
Move with the heels floating slightly, as if sweeping the soles of the feet across the tatami.

heading.en: Practice 1 Experiencing the feel of the yoko-ukemi (side breakfall) when thrown (reversed yoko-ukemi)

prose.en: Uke keeps the right leg that has been stepped out floating, falls backward and takes the yoko-ukemi.
Once students are used to it, have tori sweep uke's floating right foot with the left foot; this makes the feel of the side breakfall in an actual throw easier to grasp.
While breaking uke's balance to the rear, tori grips uke's wrist firmly and lets uke take the side breakfall safely.
By repeating the practice of falling with one leg swung up, students become proficient at the breakfall to the rear. Be sure to practise the breakfall on both the left and the right.
When uke swings the right leg up, uke uses the left foot as a support, bends the knee, comes into a low posture and takes the breakfall.

－94－
第４章　技能指導の要点
○組み方
　互いに自然体で、一方の手で相手の袖をとり、
他方の手で相手の襟をとって組み合うのが基本的
な組み方です。右組みは、互いに右自然体で左手
で相手の右外中袖をとり、右手で相手の左前襟を
とります。左組みは、右手で相手の左外中袖を取
り、左手で相手の右前襟をとります。授業では右
組みを基本として技能の指導を行います。
⑵　進退動作
　柔道は動きながら技をかけたり、相手の技を防いだりするので、自分の姿勢を安定させながら移
動することが大切です。この進退動作の基本の歩き方として「継ぎ足」「歩み足」があります。そ
の際「すり足」を用いることで姿勢を安定させます。
「継ぎ足」　一方の足が他の足を越して歩くのではなく、足を継いで歩く。
「歩み足」　主に前後への歩き方、左右交互に歩み出す普通の歩き方。
「すり足」　踵を軽く浮かせ足の裏で畳を擦るようにして移動する。
